title: Acceptance-evaluation reuse (reuseDelegationId) is never eligible after a byte-identical carry to a fresh worktree, because eligibility requires an unchanged evaluator working directory
outcome: A holder whose item was carried byte-identically to a fresh worktree can re-evaluate in the same evaluator session (reuseDelegationId) when the item and claim are the same. The working-directory check accepts a carried root, with the carry shown by an exact input-identity proof, instead of refusing every evaluator from before the carry. Nothing is reused across different inputs, items or claims.
acceptance: Acceptance-evaluation reuse (reuseDelegationId) is never eligible after a byte-identical carry to a fresh worktree, because eligibility requires an unchanged evaluator working directory is done
